scope: Frozen restore.py all322 lines, matched to frozen publisher2c732 actual Copies/archive, restore-map and complete manifest fields. No future package or recovery was executed.

checks.result: Strict JSON rejects duplicate keys/nonfinite literals; the very parsed manifest bytes are hashed and bound to the independently supplied SHA. Every sealed package file is regular, below100MB, SHA/bytes exact; recursive package set must equal manifest files plus manifest itself. Restore-map is parsed from its already bound bytes; complete publication count/quality flags and self-contained inventory set are checked.

Relative POSIX mapping paths reject absolute, traversal, backslash, NUL and noncanonical forms. Original_path must exactly equal fixed original workspace plus workspace_relative. Duplicate targets, file/ancestor conflicts, reserved receipt paths and package/output overlap are rejected; all filesystem ancestors and package entries reject symlinks. Fresh output parent must already exist.

Direct-file and shared blob aliases match publisher format. Every chunk descriptor is manifest-bound; original_relative, source alias, descriptor suffix and whole bytes/SHA agree. Each part is canonical ordinal six-digit path, positive at most25MB, contiguous offset, all nonfinal parts exactly25MB; actual per-part SHA/bytes and concatenated whole SHA/bytes are checked before creating output. All package chunk descriptors must be consumed by restore-map.

All manifest/package/restore-map/chunk/path/mode validation and final package-set recheck finish inside preflight, before exclusive output.mkdir. CLI only calls restore after successful preflight; no subprocess/scientific import or recovery side effect occurs in source-level preflight.

Fresh paths are opened xb, source body SHA is checked before/after each byte copy, target whole SHA/bytes are checked before final chmod. File modes are exact0..07777 with mode_octal agreement; uid/gid are rejected and never set. Copies create distinct files rather than hardlinks; restored file-set and modes are checked before sealing. Output and parent directories use0755; original directory modes are not claimed.

An incomplete marker is retained while copying. Success receipt is written pending and atomically renamed as the final filesystem operation only after all data checks; caught failure removes any success marker, records failed_partial_restore when diagnostic IO permits, retains partial bytes and re-raises without automatic retry. A diagnostic IO failure cannot manufacture success.
